pageProps.title: Memory Bookstore
pageProps.review: A candid review of Jung Myung-seob's novel 'Memory Bookstore', which, contrary to the novel setting of opening a bookstore for revenge, was disappointing due to its predictable story development and provocative direction.
pageProps.description: A tenacious and intellectual revenge play of a man who remembers death
pageProps.content:
## Review He opened a bookstore for revenge. Only this part was fresh. Too predictable a story and too predictable a twist, and revenge scenes that seemed unnecessary.
I can see what fun elements and twists the author wanted to include, but it's too light and easy.
The last part was probably included to give readers a sense of catharsis, but it's just provocative.
